result.title: VideoNexus: Video Perception Beyond the Reasoning Context
result.summary: Understanding long videos requires locating evidence, resolving visual details, and integrating observations into an answer. Even when relevant evidence is present, performing these operations within long, dense visual sequences burdens both perception and reasoning. Video agents enable selective inspection, but returning frames to the planner still accumulates visual information in its reasoning context. Delegating perception reduces this burden, yet sparse sampling can miss decisive details, and per-frame descriptions can preserve context growth. We introduce VideoNexus, a training-free framework that separates detailed video perception from evidence-driven planning and reasoning. The planner controls where to inspect, what to resolve, and how densely to sample. Perception sub-agents process native audio-video in independent contexts and return compact, temporally grounded evidence for iterative search and verification. Using Gemini 3.8 Flash for both planning and perception, VideoNexus achieves 88.6% accuracy on full LVBench, exceeding same-backbone static ingestion and built-in agentic processing by 3.6 and 1.1 points, respectively, at 44% of the latter's measured API cost. A paired LVBench subset ablation shows lower planner input and higher accuracy. With Kimi K3 as the shared backbone, VideoNexus improves over the official Video-GAIA ReAct harness by 8.5 points in our evaluation. These results support compact evidence exchange for combining detailed observation with efficient planning and reasoning.

AI.brief_summary: VideoNexus 是一个免训练的长视频问答框架：planner 决定查看何处、解析什么、以多大密度采样，perception 子代理在独立上下文中处理原始音视频，仅回传紧凑、时间定位的证据供迭代检索与验证，并在 LVBench 等设定上以更低 API 成本取得提升。
AI.relevance_reason: 直接对应「视觉证据筛选＋压缩状态交换」问题：它把视觉细节留在子代理上下文、只向推理侧传递紧凑证据，其准确率—成本权衡可供核查 LOOK 密度、STOP 时机与上下文增长的取舍；但交换的是显式文本证据而非 latent 状态，能否迁移到内部表示需读原文判断。
